genie_explains_flag.question: Why is EASTTEXAS-05 flagged by rule R-H2S-AUDIT (H2S safety audit)? Show the rule, its glossary definition and the data behind it.
genie_explains_flag.text:
⚠️ H2S HAZARD: This formation has known or potential hydrogen sulfide (H2S) exposure risk. Verify the following before any site entry or well operations: (1) H2S gas monitors are calibrated and active, (2) Emergency Escape Breathing Apparatus (EEBA) is available and accessible to all personnel, (3) All personnel hold current H2S Alive or equivalent certification, (4) A muster point and escape plan are established. Do not rely on this data system for real-time safety decisions — contact your HSE officer.

EASTTEXAS-05 is flagged by **R-H2S-AUDIT** because the rule **"H2S safety audit overdue"** uses the glossary term **"H2S safety audit interval"**, defined as **"Every sour well needs an on-site H2S safety audit (monitors, alarms, EEBA, contingency plan, training) at least once a year"** with a threshold of **365 days** from **Company H2S standard** owned by **HSE**. For EASTTEXAS-05, the supporting data shows **sour_classified = true**, **h2s_ppm_last_measured = 12000.0**, **last_safety_audit_date = 2025-10-01**, and **days_since_audit = 386**, which is **21 days over** the **365-day** limit. EASTTEXAS-05 also shows **h2s_risk_level = high** and **safety_status = critical**, which is consistent with the need to keep the H2S audit current.
genie_explains_flag.sql:
SELECT
  r.`rule_id`,
  r.`title`,
  r.`glossary_term`,
  g.`definition`,
  g.`threshold`,
  g.`threshold_value`,
  g.`owner`,
  g.`source`,
  h.`well_id`,
  h.`well_name`,
  h.`basin`,
  h.`h2s_risk_level`,
  h.`sour_classified`,
  h.`h2s_ppm_last_measured`,
  h.`h2s_measurement_date`,
  h.`last_safety_audit_date`,
  DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), h.`last_safety_audit_date`) AS `days_since_audit`,
  h.`safety_status`,
  h.`ppe_level`,
  h.`eeba_required`,
  h.`continuous_monitor_required`,
  h.`notes`
FROM `oil_pump_monitor_catalog`.`subsurface_command`.`engineer_rules` r
JOIN `oil_pump_monitor_catalog`.`subsurface_command`.`business_glossary` g
  ON g.`term` = r.`glossary_term`
CROSS JOIN `oil_pump_monitor_catalog`.`subsurface_command`.`well_h2s_profile` h
WHERE r.`rule_id` = 'R-H2S-AUDIT'
  AND h.`well_id` = 'EASTTEXAS-05'
